title: FileStorage.peek_data() violates stated exclusive-lock contract and crashes on concurrent pop_data()
blast_radius: Any worker thread or status endpoint polling task results with peek_data() while another thread consumes results via pop_data() throws uncaught PermissionError/FileNotFoundError crashes.
trigger_likelihood: High: reproduces in 100.0% of 50-trial multi-threaded runs with zero injected delays.
broken_invariant: FileStorage.peek_data() must acquire self.lock to honor FileStorage's exclusive-lock guarantee and prevent TOCTOU open failures when pop_data() unlinks keys.
root_cause: FileStorage documents that it uses exclusive locks around all filesystem operations (huey/storage.py:1384-1386), and pop_data() wraps unlink in with self.lock: (huey/storage.py:1590-1597), but peek_data() checks os.path.exists(filename) and opens filename without acquiring self.lock (huey/storage.py:1576-1585).

reproducer.observed_failure_output: 50/50 trials crashed (100.0%): 444 uncaught exceptions (438x PermissionError, 6x FileNotFoundError) during concurrent peek_data() vs. put_data()/pop_data(). Wrapped LockedFileStorage scored 0/50 errors.

disprover_notes: Audited FileStorage.peek_data at huey/storage.py:1576-1585; neither self.lock nor try/except FileNotFoundError guards the os.path.exists -> open TOCTOU window.
minimal_fix: Wrap FileStorage.peek_data() body in `with self.lock:` so reads serialize against pop_data() unlinks.
regression_test_strategy: Retain 50-trial 4-thread barrier peek_data() vs. pop_data() test in huey_chaos_benchmark.py asserting 0 exceptions.

title: FileStorage.enqueued_items() reads queue files without self.lock, crashing against dequeue()
blast_radius: Inspecting pending queue items (e.g., admin dashboards or metrics collectors) while worker threads call dequeue() fails repeatedly with PermissionError/FileNotFoundError.
trigger_likelihood: High: reproduces in 100.0% of 50-trial runs (1,468 uncaught exceptions across 50 trials).
broken_invariant: FileStorage.enqueued_items() must acquire self.lock so queue inspection never tries to open task files simultaneously unlinked by dequeue().
root_cause: FileStorage.dequeue() renames and unlinks queue_path files under with self.lock: (huey/storage.py:1447-1460), whereas enqueued_items() (lines 1465-1471) enumerates _get_sorted_filenames and opens each file without acquiring self.lock.

reproducer.observed_failure_output: 50/50 trials crashed (100.0%): 1,468 uncaught exceptions (990x PermissionError, 478x FileNotFoundError) when enqueued_items() raced with dequeue(). Wrapped LockedFileStorage scored 0/50 errors.

disprover_notes: Audited FileStorage.enqueued_items and scheduled_items at huey/storage.py:1465-1524; neither acquires self.lock or handles vanished queue files.
regression_test_strategy: Retain 50-trial 4-thread barrier enqueued_items() vs. dequeue() test in huey_chaos_benchmark.py asserting 0 exceptions.

title: FileStorage.result_items() walks and opens result files without self.lock, crashing against pop_data()
blast_radius: Calling result_items() concurrently with pop_data()/put_data() throws uncaught FileNotFoundError/PermissionError and aborts the snapshot.
trigger_likelihood: High: reproduces in 90.0% of 50-trial multi-threaded runs with zero injected delays.
broken_invariant: FileStorage.result_items() must acquire self.lock when walking result_path and reading files to prevent PermissionError/FileNotFoundError races.
root_cause: FileStorage.result_items() iterates os.walk(self.result_path) via _result_files() and opens each file without acquiring self.lock (huey/storage.py:1631-1647) while put_data()/pop_data() overwrite and unlink files inside with self.lock: (lines 1537-1600).

reproducer.observed_failure_output: 45/50 trials crashed (90.0%): 127 uncaught exceptions (86x PermissionError, 41x FileNotFoundError) when result_items() raced with put_data()/pop_data(). Wrapped LockedFileStorage scored 0/50 errors.

disprover_notes: Audited FileStorage.result_items at huey/storage.py:1640-1647; zero locking or missing-file tolerance exists.
regression_test_strategy: Retain 50-trial 4-thread barrier result_items() vs. put_data()/pop_data() test asserting 0 exceptions.

title: FileStorage._put_data writes temp file and calls os.replace without os.fsync
broken_invariant: Newly written temp result files must have data blocks flushed via os.fsync before os.replace so a power loss never produces an empty replacement file.
root_cause: FileStorage._put_data writes key length, key, and payload into tmp = filename + '.tmp' and exits the with block straight into os.replace(tmp, filename) (huey/storage.py:1552-1558) without fh.flush() or os.fsync(fh.fileno()).
unresolved_fact: Whether OS page-cache writeback reordering leaves zero-byte or stale data on target filesystems after an abrupt power cut.
why_blocked: Deterministic power-loss reordering between close() and os.replace() requires VM/dm-flakey block-device fault injection.
safe_verification_recipe: Run inside an isolated QEMU/dm-flakey Linux guest, issue put_data(), trigger abrupt power-off right after os.replace(), remount, and inspect file length.

title: Candidate concurrent duplicate delivery in SqliteStorage.dequeue()
disprover_evidence: SqliteStorage.dequeue enters BaseSqlStorage.db(commit=True), which holds threading.Lock() across the connection and issues BEGIN EXCLUSIVE before SELECT id, data ... LIMIT 1 and DELETE FROM task WHERE id = ?. Executed 50x 4-thread drain trials (40 tasks each): 0 duplicate/lost trials and 0 runtime errors.
rejection_reason: Combination of self.lock mutex and SQLite BEGIN EXCLUSIVE serializes dequeue read-then-delete atomically across concurrent threads and processes.

title: Candidate RuntimeError in MemoryStorage.result_items() (unlocked dict copy vs. put_data/pop_data)
disprover_evidence: MemoryStorage.result_items omits with self._lock: and returns dict(self._results), but CPython 3.13 executes PyDict_Copy atomically in C without releasing the GIL. Executed 50x 4-thread barrier stress trials against put_data/pop_data: 0/50 trials raised RuntimeError (note: free-threaded PEP 703 Python builds without GIL would still need self._lock).
rejection_reason: Hypothesis could not be reproduced on standard CPython 3.13 due to C-level PyDict_Copy atomicity under the GIL; rejected per evidence-gated rule requiring executed failing reproducer.
